assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a seamless-looking rectangular macro texture of real hair for an interactive hair-cutting game's Canvas layer, NOT a portrait. Input image role: reference ONLY for the exact dark warm brown tone, smooth straight natural hair strands and soft photographic sheen of the boy's hair. Primary request: fill the ENTIRE image edge to edge with densely layered real straight dark brown hair flowing vertically DOWNWARD with slight organic bends, highly detailed individual slender hairs, natural brown shadow and muted tan highlights, soft diffuse indoor lighting. Flat frontal macro view of the hair surface. No hairline, no roots with skin, no parting scalp, no head shape or wig silhouette, no face, no ears, no person, no skin, no tools, no text, no borders, no gaps or background. The texture must be suitable for sampling narrow long strips from any region to paint curved individual locks over the existing portrait. Keep the brown tone natural, not black paint, bright orange, glossy plastic, cartoon or illustration. Portrait or square texture frame.
assets.notes: V1 hair texture retained for source history; V2 no longer loads this texture in the live salon.
